description: Summary of one procuring entity in Japan (ministry, agency, prefecture, city, public corporation): award counts by year and category, most frequent suppliers, and its currently open notices. If the name matches several entities, candidates are returned instead of a guess. When records exist only per department (e.g. 岡崎市 総務部契約課), a city or prefecture name returns the departments combined (`departments`). 発注機関・官公庁・自治体

area.description: Prefecture, to tell same-name entities apart. Accepts 福岡県, 福岡, Fukuoka, 40 (JIS code), national (国の機関)

buyer.description: Name (e.g. 福岡市, 国交省) or buyer_id

response_format.description: concise (default): fewer fields per row. detailed: adds IDs, method, original URL and retrieval date per row.

name: get_buyer_profile

access.description: Whether this result is shown in full through this server: public = yes; not_public_now = the item exists but this server does not return it at present (e.g. a notice whose deadline has passed); login_required / plan_required = the item exists but is available only under other access conditions of the site (sign-in, or a plan)

cite_as.description: One-line source citation for this result: the page title on 入札案件観測所, the data date, and the URL of that page (same as `url`).

changes.description: With changed_since: what happened to this notice on or after that date (new, or which field changed with before/after)

deadline_kind.description: What the `deadline` date is, read from the notice's procedure text: participation application, bid submission, both, opening, question, notification (not a deadline for bidders), document issue, briefing, post-review documents (only for the bidder asked after the opening; never used as `deadline`), or unknown

notice_type.description: What kind of procedure this is: an open tender anyone qualified can apply for, a nominated tender (指名競争: only nominated companies), a request for comments/information (意見招請: not a tender), or a list of small goods items

related.description: Facts related to this result (counts) and the tool call that returns them

restricted.description: Items that exist but are not returned here, with their access value. An item listed here is not missing from the data.

title: 発注機関の要約
